payload.posture: Read Luke 20:1–8 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states luke’s account keeps Jesus teaching good news in the temple while leaders refuse to locate John’s baptism in heaven or human action. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of John the Baptist's story.
